notes:
Lead: product team (CTO + infra lead) evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated path. Mid-market analytics SaaS, multi-tenant product search + chat feature. Wants predictable latency for live product chat and lower per-token cost at scale.

POC ask: 2-week Dedicated POC (non-prod) to validate latency, autoscale and routing. Customer explicitly requested: canary rollout, model-variant fallbacks, region failover, and fast rollback.

Proposed POC outline (from SE):
- Dedicated pool sizing: 2x A100-equivalent nodes (profile to be finalized)
- Canary: route ~10% production-simulated traffic to Dedicated pool in us-west for 48 hours, monitor p50/p95/p99 latency and token cost.
- Fallbacks: primary fallback path = Hosted API in us-east (same model family); secondary = quantized smaller model variant (3-bit) deployed in us-east to cap cost under load.
- Model variants: base open-weights (llama-2-70B-compat), 8-bit quantized and 3-bit quantized smaller variant for cost spikes. SE to provide recommended family.
- Rollback plan: automatic traffic shift back to Hosted pool on sustained error rate >2% or p99 latency >750ms for >5m window. Manual rollback runbook documented.

Acceptance criteria (customer):
- p95 latency <350ms on chat generation for 512-token context with simulated user mix.
- Sustained throughput of 150 reqs/s on 8 concurrent workers.
- Per-token cost reduction >=30% vs current Hosted baseline.
- No data exfiltration signals in audit logs; SSO + KMS integration validated.

Legal/Security: InfoSec ran initial checklist, asked for DPA updates and EU residency confirmation for a subset of logs. Provided SOC2 pack; SEC ticket raised for encryption at rest details (SEC-1178).

Customer quotes: "Need safe fallback if dedicated goes hot — can't have product chat degrade for enterprise customers." — CTO

Open questions: precise HW profile (GPU type/quantization perf), length of workload bursts (they cited 30m bursts during product launches), exact EU region needed for residency.

Next steps (short):
- Finalize SOW and commit dates for 2-week Dedicated POC (owner: Jordan)
- SE to produce canary routing YAML + rollback hooks by 2026-03-18 (owner: Priya)
- Legal to return signed DPA (owner: legal/verdance)
- Budget owner decision expected 2026-03-20 — follow-up scheduled.

Stakes: mid-market expansion account; POC success likely to convert to reserved Dedicated contract (annual).
